answer: Mango: plant grafts 10x10m, no irrigation during flowering (Dec-Feb). Spray 2% KNO3 to induce flowering. Bag fruits against fruit fly.

Seed tips: Always use certified seed. Treat seed with Trichoderma or Carbendazim (2g/kg) before sowing to prevent soil-borne diseases. Sow at recommended spacing and depth (generally 2-3x seed diameter). Check the Crops library in this app for crop-specific guidance.
Tomato: 20-27°C, well-drained loam, pH 6-7. Transplant at 60x45cm, stake plants, avoid overhead watering (blight risk). Calcium prevents blossom-end rot.

Banana: 26-30°C, rich loam, tissue-culture saplings at 1.8x1.8m. Heavy feeder: 300g N, 100g P, 300g K per plant/year. Harvest in 11-12 months.
